patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.achroous_: I Can Count to Ten with One Hand

Attack Speed increased by [Trait Level/2] points, but each attack has a [Trait Level x10%] chance to deal 5 magic damage to the user, and causes Nausea I & Weakness I for 3 seconds every 5 seconds to creatures within 5 blocks.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.acril_ing: On attack, consumes 20 mana: Releases a [Trait Level+1] level Chain Lightning (10s cooldown)
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.aethersen: When injured, releases a meteor shower to attack your enemies
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.alexandri:
Durability > 66%: Attack Power ×1.5
Durability < 33%: Attack Power ×0.5
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.amber.des: When injured, [Trait Level ×10%] chance to gain: Strength III + Speed III (5 seconds)
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.amns.desc: When 'amns' is entered in chat: Randomly gain a vanilla effect.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.ancient_m: As sanity fluctuates, your attacks have a chance to drive enemies insane, causing them to attack other creatures indiscriminately for a short time.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.animated_: Per level of Sharpness: Deal additional (0.5 × level + 0.5) damage. Attacks have a [Trait Level × 10%] chance to restore 1-3 durability.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.aquamarin: Randomly consumes 1-10 additional durability to increase this damage multiplier by 0.1.
Provides damage increase based on current mana. 1% damage increase per 10 mana, max increase (Trait Level * 20)%. When mana is below 50, reduces damage by 20%.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.arrow.des: When hit by arrow damage: 10% chance to fully block. Upon successful block, restore 10% health.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.atalphait: Attack deals original damage + 25% and causes a small area splash (splash damage is 50%). Splash damage continues to spread (damage reduces by 50% each spread).
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.attack_ta: Attack Power -30% but attacks have a chance to apply Taunt.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.bismuthge: When attacking a target with armor below [Trait Level × 4], deal 10 additional damage.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.blazing_magic: After casting a Blazing school spell: [Trait Level] × 20% chance to gain 1 stack of Scorching Mana. Can stack during duration (max 10 stacks).
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.bloodjade: Every 5 attacks: Deal damage equal to the user's max health to the target, while deducting 50% of the user's health.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.boron_ingot.d: When you attack an enemy, reduces the enemy's maximum health.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.bribery.desc: When you give a gift to a villager, restore some health and 1 Sanity, and gain the Hero of the Village effect for 30 seconds.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.calamatiu: For each creature on fire within 5 blocks of self, grant all players in this range a Health Boost effect of level [Trait Level + Number of Burning Creatures] for 10 seconds.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.carbonati: Sneak + Right-click weapon: Randomly gain 1 level of a random enchantment. Each enhancement consumes Current Level × 10% durability (minimum 1). Increases the corresponding enchantment by 1 level. Cannot enhance if durability is insufficient.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.celeslar_ingo: For each creature within 2 × <Trait Level> blocks, gain 1 level of Damage Boost. Maximum of 3 × <Trait Level> levels.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.citrine.d: Every 30 experience levels +1 Attack Power. Max 900 levels.
Your mana cost is reduced by 14%.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.combustio: Your attacks will extend the burn duration of the target.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.comet_trait.d: Your arrow damage, upon hitting an enemy, will cause a falling star to strike.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.corroded.desc: Damage influenced by weapon durability: 20% durability: Damage × 2. 20-50% durability: Damage × 1.4. 50%+ durability: No bonus.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.cosmos_aurora: During rain, spell attack power increases by [10 × Trait Level]%, and increases player's lightning spell power by [Trait Level]%.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.cursium_i: Periodically gain Ghost Form but cannot use the Cursium set revival effect.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.dragonskill.d: When attacking dragon-type creatures, each attack deals 10 additional damage, stacking up to 5 times.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_f: Attacks apply 1 stack of Armor Break. When enemy armor reaches zero, ignites them for 60 seconds. Attacking an enemy with zero armor and burning deals additional massive magic damage and removes the burn effect. Attacks apply a Bleed debuff. When the target's Bleed stacks reach 10, consumes 8 stacks and grants the player 20 Golden Hearts.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_i: Attacks apply 1 stack of Freezing. After accumulating 10 stacks, freeze the enemy. Attacking a frozen enemy deals 20 additional freeze damage and removes the freeze effect. Attacks apply a Bleed debuff. When the target's Bleed stacks reach 10, grants the player a one-time (10-second) Absorption effect.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_l: Attacks apply 1 stack of High Voltage. Attacking an enemy with High Voltage deals 20 damage to surrounding enemies without High Voltage and applies High Voltage to them once. When High Voltage stacks reach a certain level, deals lightning damage and clears their High Voltage stacks. Attacks apply a Bleed debuff. When the target's Bleed stacks reach 10, consumes 8 stacks and grants the player a one-time (10-second) Absorption effect.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.dropped_e: Drain more experience from defeated enemies.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.echo_ingot.de: Makes you immune to Darkness, and hitting a target applies <Trait Level> stacks of Slowness, <Trait Level> stacks of Paralysis, and <Trait Level>*2 stacks of Bleeding. Cooldown 15s.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.emerald.d: Every 2 seconds: Consume 4 durability of the main-hand weapon to gain the Hero of the Village effect.
When eating, teleports randomly like an Enderman.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.eternal_s: In the Starlight dimension: Gain 10% melee attack power per level. Outside the Starlight dimension: Gain 10% attack speed per level.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.exalted_b: (Effect Level × 2)% chance: Consume 10 experience levels to completely negate damage.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.exp_to_de: Upon receiving fatal damage: Consume all experience levels to gain Absorption of level 'Experience Level' for 'Experience Level' / 5 seconds.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.farmersdeligh: You are a farmer's son, you cannot kill whoever you want.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.fiery_tea: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection status. Attack Power -10%. Gain 1 stack of Guardian. Gain Fire Resistance. Fire Spell Power +10%. Sanity < 0: Gain Despair status. Attack Power +30%. Periodically gain Blazing Strike. Blazing Strike deals [Trait Level × 10] levels of Burn damage. Immune to Seven Sins Corruption.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.fluxing.d: Against burning/lava-immersed enemies: Deal 1 + (0.2 × level) times damage.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.frosted_h: The icy grip contains magical energy, increasing mana cap and recovery rate, and enhancing frost spell power.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.garnet.de: When ignited: Melee attacks attach [Trait Level + 1] level Tracer Bullet. Cooldown 5s. No mana cost.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.gaze.desc: When you stare at an entity, applies Gaze effect to the entity you are looking at every 10 seconds.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.gift_heav: When near death, consumes your Silent Gear weapon and negates the attack.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.gobber: May Your Journey Be Full of Curses and Blessings I
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.gobber.desc: Attacks gain 10% independent damage bonus, and triggers synergy effects with other Gobber traits.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.gobber_end: May Your Journey Be Full of Curses and Blessings III
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.gobber_end.de: Attacks gain 30% independent damage bonus, and triggers synergy effects with other Gobber traits.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.gobber_nether: May Your Journey Be Full of Curses and Blessings II
Attacks gain 20% independent damage bonus, and triggers synergy effects with other Gobber traits.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.golem_ste: Increases your draw speed and projectile damage.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.hallowed_: Increases Scythe mastery and enhances holy spell power.
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.high_health.d: Deals extra damage when attacking high-health enemies.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.ignitium_: Your attacks grant entities a corresponding level of Fiery Gaze effect.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.intrinsic: Every 5 experience levels +1% damage. Max 900 levels.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.iridescen: Damage dealt randomly increases by [Trait Level] ~ [Trait Level + 6] points.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.ironwood_: Attacks consume 15 Sanity and release Entangling Roots. During casting, gain 80% damage reduction. When Sanity insufficient: - Consume 40% max health. - Forcibly release 1 set of roots (can toggle this function with key).
patchouli.gui.trait.kubejs.knockback.des: User's movement speed is reduced, but attacks pull enemies towards themselves. Pull force: 1.0 + (0.5 × Effect Level).
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.lacrima.d: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection status. Attack Power -20%. Gain 1 stack of Guardian (Damage Reduction = Stack %). Sanity < 0: Gain Despair status. Attack Power +30%. Gain Vulnerability. Immune to Seven Sins Corruption.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.life_drai: Attacks grant yourself Fury Assault effect, reducing own health by 2% per second. Attacks stack the effect, stacking does not increase self-damage, max 5 stacks. At 5 stacks, the attack deals 300% damage.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.luck.desc: Attacks have a 10% × Effect Level chance to trigger, dealing extra (20 × Level - Luck Value)% damage, minimum 5% damage bonus.
patchouli.gui.trait.silentgear.lunium_no: Increases your Soul Shield capacity and recovery rate.
